run_impala_catch: run the single-process IMPALA example on the bsuite Catch environment using absl app
run_actor_loop: run an actor thread that pulls params and pushes unrolls until a stop signal is set
build_impala_learner: build a Learner with an agent, PRNG key, RMSProp optimizer, batch size, and discount factor
construct_impala_agent: construct an Agent with num actions, observation spec, and a Haiku network class like CatchNet
spawn_actor_threads: spawn multiple Actor threads on separate threads that interact with the environment and push data to the learner
